Title: [lsj] Playing political action cards to gain votes

Messages.Author: Thanqol
Messages.Body:
In a referendum you may use one political action card to gain a vote.
But how is it when you use a political action card to call the
referendum? I figured it counts as the vote you can gain from
political action cards (the rulebook says so) but there are others who
claim that you may play an political action card to gain a vote, in
addition to the card you use to call the referendum. Which is correct?

Messages.Author: Martin Bruset Solberg
Messages.Body:
In a referendum you may discard one political action card (PAC) to gain one
vote. But when you use a PAC to call the referendum, do you still have the
opportunity to discard PAC to gain a vote? I think the rulebook says that
the PAC used to call the referendum provides the vote you are obliged to get
from PACs. Is this correct?

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Martin Bruset Solberg wrote:
>
> In a referendum you may discard one political action card (PAC) to gain one
> vote. But when you use a PAC to call the referendum, do you still have the
> opportunity to discard PAC to gain a vote? I think the rulebook says that

No.

> the PAC used to call the referendum provides the vote you are [allowed] to get

> from PACs. Is this correct?

Yes.

one
> vote.

yes.

> But when you use a PAC to call the referendum, do you still have the
> opportunity to discard PAC to gain a vote? I think the rulebook says that
> the PAC used to call the referendum provides the vote you are obliged to
get
> from PACs. Is this correct?

the rulebook is correct, yes ;)
You can gain one voice by burning a political card from your hand. But if
you called yourself the vote by using a political card (like kine resource
contested), then you are not allowed to do this.

reyda
